# Researchomatic

> > Researchomatic is a free academic e-library offering 4M+ research papers, essays, and assignments across 100+ subject areas for students and researchers.

Researchomatic provides comprehensive access to academic content across sciences, business, humanities, and professional fields. The platform enables students to browse, search, and access peer-reviewed research materials organized by subject matter.

## Key Topics

- research papers
- academic essays
- student resources

- essay database

## Browse & Discover

- [Browse Subjects for Research and Citations](https://www.researchomatic.com/subjects): Subject browse interface for 4M+ academic essays, research papers, and assignments

## Business & Finance

- [Business Research Papers & Essays](https://www.researchomatic.com/business): Free e-library of business research papers, essays, and academic content
- [Finance Research & Academic Essays](https://www.researchomatic.com/finance): Free e-library of finance research papers and academic essays
- [Accounting Research & Essays](https://www.researchomatic.com/accounting): Free e-library of accounting research: essays, term papers, dissertations
- [Financial Analysis Papers](https://www.researchomatic.com/financial-analysis): Free e-library of financial analysis essays and research papers
- [Economics Research Library](https://www.researchomatic.com/economics): Free e-library of economics: microeconomics, macroeconomics research
- [Auditing Research Papers](https://www.researchomatic.com/auditing): Free e-library of auditing research papers, essays, and student resources

## Science & Technology

- [Biology & Microbiology Research](https://www.researchomatic.com/biology): Free e-library of biology and microbiology research papers, essays
- [Chemistry Essays & Research Papers](https://www.researchomatic.com/chemistry): Free e-library of chemistry essays, research papers, and student materials
- [Engineering Research & Essays](https://www.researchomatic.com/engineering): Free e-library of engineering essays, research papers, and topics

## Humanities & Social Sciences

- [History Essays & Research Papers](https://www.researchomatic.com/history): Free e-library of history essays, research papers, and academic content
- [English Literature & Language Research](https://www.researchomatic.com/english): Free e-library of English literature, poetry, language research papers
- [Arts & Cultural Studies](https://www.researchomatic.com/arts): Free e-library of arts research: essays, papers, cultural studies topics
- [Communications & Media Research](https://www.researchomatic.com/communications-and-media): Free e-library of communications and media research papers, essays
- [Education Research Papers](https://www.researchomatic.com/education): Free e-library of education research papers and academic resources

## Law & Professional Studies

- [Law Research Papers & Essays](https://www.researchomatic.com/law): Free e-library of law research papers and legal academic essays
- [Law School Essays & Research](https://www.researchomatic.com/law-school): Free e-library of law school essays and research papers for students
- [Ethics & Business Ethics Research](https://www.researchomatic.com/ethics): Free e-library of ethics and business ethics research papers, essays

## Health & Alternative Studies

- [Alternative Medicine & Holistic Research](https://www.researchomatic.com/alternative-medicine): Free e-library on alternative medicine, homeopathy, meditation research
